title: Rest Parameters Check
description: Gathering leftover args into an array; rest must be last.

questions.explanation: Rest collects args into an array. Empty rest is `[]`, so the loop sum is `0`.
`prefix` takes the first arg; `parts` is `["a","b","c"]`, joined with `-`.

questions.prompt: Which rest parameter declaration is valid?
questions.explanation: Rest must be the last parameter. Placing it before other params is a syntax error.
Without rest, extras are ignored (`01.7.6`). With rest, leftovers stay in an array.
Max of the list is 9. Empty rest → `nums.length === 0` → `null`.
